epic.title: Budget app MVP
epic.body: Tracks the MVP from PLAN.md: track transactions (M1), budget per category (M2), own your data (M3).

issues.title: Parse and format amounts as integer cents
issues.body: Add `src/lib/amount.ts` with `parseAmount(text)` (accepts `12`, `12.5`, `12,50`; rejects empty, negative and more than two decimals) returning integer cents, and `formatAmount(cents, currency)` using `Intl.NumberFormat`. Everything else stores and adds cents, never floats.
acceptance: parseAmount("12,50") returns 1250 and parseAmount("12.5") returns 1250
parseAmount returns null for "", "-3", "abc" and "1.234"
formatAmount(1250, "USD") returns "$12.50" in the en-US locale
Unit tests cover every case above

issues.title: Versioned localStorage store for budget data
issues.body: Add `src/lib/store.ts`: one JSON document `{version: 1, transactions: [], budgets: {}, settings: {currency: "USD"}}` under the key `budget-app`. `load()` returns the default document when the key is missing or unreadable; `save(doc)` writes it. Types for Transaction, Budgets and Settings live here.
acceptance: load() returns the default document when localStorage is empty
load() returns the default document, without throwing, when the stored value is not valid JSON
save() then load() round-trips a document with two transactions
Tests run in jsdom and reset localStorage between cases

issues.title: Default categories
issues.body: Add `src/lib/categories.ts` with the default categories from PLAN.md, each `{id, name, kind: "expense" | "income"}`, and `categoryName(id)` that falls back to "Other" for an unknown id.
acceptance: The six default categories from PLAN.md exist with stable ids
Exactly one default category is of kind income
categoryName returns "Other" for an unknown id

issues.title: Add an expense or income from a form
issues.body: Replace the starter home page with the app shell and a `TransactionForm`: amount, date (defaults to today), category and an optional note. Submitting validates with parseAmount, saves through the store and clears the form.
acceptance: Submitting a valid amount adds one transaction to the store with today's date by default
An invalid amount shows an inline error and saves nothing
Every field has a visible label and the form works with the keyboard only
A Testing Library test covers the valid and the invalid submit

issues.title: List the month's transactions, newest first
issues.body: Add a `TransactionList` under the form that shows the current month's transactions newest first: date, category, note and the formatted amount (income in the success colour). Show an empty state when there are none.
acceptance: Only transactions from the current month are listed, newest first
Amounts use formatAmount with the settings currency
With no transactions the list shows "Nothing yet this month"
A test renders the list from a seeded store

issues.title: Edit and delete a transaction
issues.body: Each list row gets Edit (reopens the form filled in, Save replaces the transaction) and Delete (asks for confirmation, then removes it).
acceptance: Editing a transaction changes it in place and keeps its id
Delete asks for confirmation and removes only that transaction
Both actions are reachable by keyboard and have accessible names
Tests cover edit, delete and cancelled delete

issues.title: Switch between months
issues.body: Add previous and next month buttons with the month name (for example "November 2026") above the list. The list and, later, the budget summary follow the selected month.
acceptance: Previous and next change the listed month by one
The heading shows the month and year from Intl.DateTimeFormat
A test moves back one month and sees only that month's transactions

issues.title: Set a monthly budget per category
issues.body: Add `src/lib/budgets.ts` (`setBudget(categoryId, cents)`, `budgetFor(categoryId)`) and a `BudgetEditor` listing each expense category with an amount field. Budgets apply to every month.
acceptance: Setting a budget saves it through the store and survives a reload
An empty field removes that category's budget
Income categories have no budget field
Tests cover set, change and remove

issues.title: Show spent and remaining per category
issues.body: Add `src/lib/summary.ts` (`summarize(transactions, budgets, month)` returning spent and remaining cents per category) and a `BudgetSummary` above the list, for the selected month.
acceptance: summarize adds only expenses of the given month, in cents
Remaining is budget minus spent; categories without a budget show spent only
The summary follows the month switcher
Unit tests for summarize and a render test for BudgetSummary

issues.title: Warn when a category goes over budget
issues.body: In the summary, a category over its budget shows the overspent amount in the danger colour with the text "Over by $X", and the app title shows how many categories are over.
acceptance: A category at 101% of its budget shows "Over by" with the overspent amount
The warning is text, not colour alone
A test covers under, exactly at, and over budget

issues.title: Export and import all data as JSON
issues.body: Add `src/lib/backup.ts` (`exportDoc()`, `importDoc(text)` that validates version and shape before replacing anything) and Export and Import buttons in a footer. Import asks for confirmation because it replaces the current data.
acceptance: Export downloads budget-app-YYYY-MM-DD.json containing the whole document
Importing an exported file restores the same transactions and budgets
A file with the wrong version or shape is rejected with a message and changes nothing
Tests cover round-trip and rejection

issues.title: Choose the display currency
issues.body: Add a Settings panel with a currency select (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF). It is stored in settings and every amount uses it. JPY formats with no decimals; stored cents are unchanged.
acceptance: Changing the currency re-renders every amount in the new currency
The choice survives a reload
formatAmount handles a zero-decimal currency (JPY)
Tests cover the select and the JPY formatting
